nomorezombies.config.title: NoMoreZombies Config
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.waveSou:
Whether to play a spawn sound on each wave
in Alien Arcadium (enabled by default).
Requires the wave spawn sound master switch
to be enabled first.
Sound ID and pitch are configured below.

in Dead End (enabled by default).
Requires the wave spawn sound master switch

Sound ID and pitch are configured below.

Requires the wave spawn sound master switch

nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.precede:
Sound ID played on every wave except the final one.
Defaults to the note block pling (minecraft:block.note_block.pling).
Accepts any valid Minecraft sound event ID.

Pitch of the standard (non-final) wave spawn sound
(range 0.0 ~ 2.0, default 2.0).
The default value is set to the maximum,
ensuring the alert is prominent.
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.lastWav:
Sound ID played when the final wave of each round spawns.
Defaults to the experience orb pickup sound
(minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup), which has a deeper tone.

Pitch of the final-wave spawn sound (range 0.0 ~ 2.0, default 0.5).
The lower default contrasts with the standard wave pitch
for easy distinction.
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.finalWa:
Master switch for the final-wave countdown sound
(off by default, hotkey-bindable). When enabled, a 3-2-1
countdown plays before the final wave of each round.
Applies to all maps, independent of the per-map switches above.
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.countDo:
Sound ID played during the 3-2-1 countdown before the final wave.
Defaults to the note block pling (minecraft:block.note_block.pling).
Played once for each countdown tick (3, 2, 1).

Pitch of the countdown sound (range 0.0 ~ 2.0, default 1.5).
Set between the standard wave and final-wave pitches
so all three are easily distinguishable.
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.colorAl:
Master switch for the Alien Arcadium dangerous wave alert
(off by default, hotkey-bindable). When enabled, waves spawning
boss-level enemies (Old One or Giant) are highlighted with a
distinctive color in the HUD for quick identification.
nomorezombies.config.powerup.comment.pow:
Master switch for powerup refresh prediction
(hotkey-bindable, off by default). When enabled,
the predicted next-refresh round is announced
in chat at the start of each round.
This group contains only this switch and the
output target — no separate off toggle is
provided.
nomorezombies.config.powerup.comment.ale:
Specifies the output destination for powerup drop
and prediction alerts: Self (local chat only),
Party (/pc), or Public (/ac).
Selecting "Self" is the quietest option;
selecting Public makes messages visible to the
entire lobby for the rest of the game.
The on/off control is handled by the powerup
prediction master switch; this setting provides
no independent off toggle.
nomorezombies.config.aacommand.comment.o:
Specifies the output destination for AA auto-commander
messages: Self (local chat only), Party (/pc),
or Public (/ac).
The three tiers directly reuse the powerup alert
output channel; no "Off" option is provided.
The on/off control is handled by the AA auto-commander
master switch; this setting only determines where
messages are sent.
nomorezombies.config.aacommand.comment.t:
Defines the format of the per-round auto-commander
message template. The following placeholders are
replaced with actual data at runtime:
{round} = round number
{point} = recommended spots
{boss} = boss (Giant / Old One / Giant + Old One / None)
{difficulty} = round difficulty (I ~ V)
An empty value or a template containing unknown
variables automatically falls back to the default
template. The default template follows the client
language and is rewritten automatically on switch.
nomorezombies.config.record.comment.roun:
Specifies the frequency of per-round stats chat
broadcasts: every round, every 5 rounds,
or every 10 rounds.
A single frequency tier is shared across all maps
with no per-map override.
The on/off control is handled by the round stats
master switch.
Note: AA is a 105-round marathon while shorter maps
cap at ~40 rounds, so the same tier naturally
produces different broadcast counts per game.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideGo:
Hides money gain messages, such as '+N Gold'.
Off by default. Knockdown / revive / powerup
pickup messages are deliberately excluded:
team stats and powerup detection depend on them.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideWi:
Hides window repair messages — start, finish,
and 'window repaired' notifications.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideHi:
Hides shooting hit notifications,
such as 'X hit the target!'.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideLu:
Hides all messages related to opening lucky chests.
Off by default.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideOp:
Hides messages about opening or unlocking areas.
Off by default.
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hidePl:
Hides player join and leave chat messages,
such as 'X left the game'.
Once hidden, team statistics no longer rely on this
chat message for the LEFT event; the scoreboard is
read directly instead, so accuracy is unaffected.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.waveSou:
Master switch for wave spawn sounds (bindable, off by default).
Controls only playback or muting — covers the per-wave
spawn cue and the final-wave 3-2-1 countdown.
When off, all of the above are silenced.
Map scope, sound IDs, and pitches are on the Global page.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.recordE:
Master switch for round-stats broadcast (bindable, off by default).
Controls only whether round-time stats are broadcast.
Broadcast density (every round / every 5 rounds /
every 10 rounds) is configured per map on the Global page.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.utility:
Master switch for all HUDs
(off by default, same behaviour as Tweakeroo).
When off, every HUD is hidden unconditionally —
overrides the per-HUD visibility toggles in the editor.
Each HUD defaults to visible: enable the master switch
and all appear; hide individual HUDs in the editor as needed.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.teammat:
Draws boxes around rostered teammates:
green for active combatants, yellow for downed bodies.
Real-time teammate status tracking.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zombieE:
Draws red boxes around zombies, wolves, blazes,
and other hostile mobs for quick threat identification.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.powerup:
Draws a white box around spawned powerup armor stands,
preventing powerups from being overlooked due to obscure placement.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.entityH:
Renders a health bar above hostile entity heads.
Independent of the entity ESP —
the two features do not affect each other.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.teammat:
Render mode for teammate ESP.
Normal: standard depth-tested rendering.
Through walls: visible through obstacles.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zombieE:
Render mode for zombie ESP.
Normal: standard depth-tested rendering.
Through walls: visible through obstacles.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.powerup:
Render mode for powerup ESP.
Normal: standard depth-tested rendering.
Through walls: visible through obstacles.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.healthB:
Render mode for zombie health bar.
Normal: standard depth-tested rendering.
Through walls: visible through obstacles.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.through:
Maximum range (blocks) for through-wall rendering:
entities beyond this distance are no longer shown through walls —
the ESP box falls back to depth-tested only, the health bar to
normal depth-tested text. Applies to all ESP types and the health bar.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.playerI: Renders nearby players as translucent to reduce visual obstruction.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.hideBos:
Suppresses the vanilla BossBarHud (top of screen):
when enabled, the boss bar is no longer rendered.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.hideSco:
Hides the vanilla scoreboard (Hypixel right-side sidebar):
rendering only. The mod continues to read and modify
scoreboard data normally; hiding the display does not
break any logic that depends on the scoreboard.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.rightCl:
Disables all right-click actions except firing:
crosshair ray ignores invisible armor stands
(holograms: door prices, machine hints, powerup labels),
and interactive block right-click responses are skipped.
Note: weapon purchases and door opening are unavailable
while enabled; disable temporarily when interaction is needed.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.noGunFi:
Cancels muzzle-flash, smoke, and spark particles near
the player (about 5.1 blocks) at the inbound-packet level.
Only active in Zombies while a zombie gun is held
in the main hand; zero outgoing packets.
Affects local display only — other players still see
your muzzle flash as normal. Off by default.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.noFireE:
Removes the on-screen fire overlay when burning
(off by default).
Single toggle: cancels rendering without redrawing;
other render passes are unaffected.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.aaComma:
Master switch for the Alien Arcadium auto-commander
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, round guidance is automatically announced
at the start of each round using the output destination
and message template configured on the Global page
(recommended spots, boss info, difficulty).
Effective only on Alien Arcadium (AA).
The associated HUD is independently controlled by the
Utility HUD master switch and the per-HUD toggle
in the HUD editor.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zoomEna:
Master switch for the smooth zoom feature
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, pressing the zoom key configured
on the Global page (default C) inside a Zombies
game smoothly zooms the view.
Magnification, animation duration, easing curve,
and key behaviour are all configured on the
Global page; this toggle only controls whether
the feature is active.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.alwaysS:
Master switch for permanent sneaking
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, forced sneaking is applied:
crouch animation, edge-fall prevention,
and reduced collision box — running through
the full vanilla sneak state machine without
entering abnormal states.
By default, not active inside GUIs (inventory,
etc.); to change this, see the Global page.

Master switch for permanent sprinting
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, pressing W to move forward
automatically triggers sprinting — equivalent
to holding the sprint key at all times.
All vanilla sprint termination conditions
(hunger, blindness, submerged in water,
using an item) are fully preserved.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.gammaOv:
Master switch for the gamma override
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, the game brightness is forced to
the override value configured on the Global page
(default 16, night-vision level, not limited
by the vanilla 0~1 brightness slider).
Disabling restores the player's original brightness.
Purely client-side visual; no packets sent.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.freeCam:
Master switch for Free Camera
(off by default, hotkey-bindable).
When enabled, the render view detaches to a
surrogate camera entity — the camera breaks free
from the body and flies freely (WASD movement
+ mouse steering), while the player's body
remains frozen in place.
The camera's movement and interaction capabilities
are controlled by the playerMovement /
playerInputs sub-options on the Global page.
Disabling restores the view instantly with zero
residue on the player.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.openCon:
Opens the configuration screen
(default key combination Z+X) — one press takes
you straight to the MaLiLib config page; one of
the most commonly used entry points.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.openHud:
Opens the HUD editor — the drag-and-drop
interface for HUD positioning, scaling,
and per-element visibility.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.apiKey:
Player data query: Hypixel API Key
(masked display + encrypted local storage).
The plaintext is only read internally by the
query logic; the text field always shows a mask.
A free key is available at
https://developer.hypixel.net.
Re-enter after switching Minecraft accounts.
The hotkey to open the query screen is
configured separately below.
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.openQue:
Opens the player data query screen
(free query / in-game query) — the sole entry
point for the query feature.
Free query: any player; in-game query: players
of the current game.
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.zoomKe:
Key that controls zoom (default C). Its behaviour is
determined by the Key Behaviour setting — hold or toggle.
Smooth zoom is implemented via FOV division (injected
into GameRenderer.getFov): it does not re-render geometry
and is purely a visual magnification.
Only active when ZOOM_ENABLED is enabled on the Utility
page and the player is currently in a Zombies game.
A simplified adaptation of Zoomify.
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.initia:
Magnification factor when fully zoomed in (1.0 ~ 10.0,
default 4.0, matching Zoomify's default).
Higher magnification reveals more detail but also
amplifies camera shake.
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.zoomIn:
Duration of the zoom-in animation in seconds
(0.1 ~ 5.0, default 1.0).
Excessively short values may cause visual discomfort;
excessively long values impair aiming responsiveness.
The default of 1.0 s is the recommended balance point.
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.zoomOu:
Duration of the zoom-out animation in seconds
(0.1 ~ 5.0, default 0.5).
The default is half the zoom-in duration, ensuring
prompt field-of-view recovery.
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.easing:
Transition style (easing curve) for the zoom animation.
Zoom-in applies the selected curve; zoom-out
automatically uses its inverse.
Default: Ease Out Exponential, matching Zoomify.
Ease Out Exponential: highest initial rate, rapid
deceleration toward the end.
Ease Out Sine: smooth and gentle throughout.
Linear: constant speed, no acceleration.
Instant: immediate jump, no transition animation.
nomorezombies.config.sneak.name.alwaysSn: Allow sneaking while GUI is open
nomorezombies.config.sneak.prettyName.al: Allow sneaking while GUI is open
nomorezombies.config.sneak.comment.alway:
The master switch lives under QoL 'Always Sneak';
this group contains only this sub-option.
Controls whether forced sneaking remains active
inside GUIs (inventory, containers, etc.).
When enabled, forced sneaking is maintained even
while a GUI is open.
Off by default: forced sneaking is released inside GUIs
to prevent unintended crouching during menu interactions.
nomorezombies.config.gamma.comment.gamma:
The master switch lives under QoL 'Gamma Override';
this group contains only the brightness value.
The brightness value applied to lighting when
the override is active
(0.0 ~ 32.0, default 16.0, night-vision level),
not limited by the vanilla brightness slider's 0~1 range.
Technical note: the vanilla brightness option's
codec accepts [0, 1];
writing 16 directly causes GameOptions.save()
to encode an out-of-range value, triggering
a resource reload and black screen.
The vanilla option field is therefore left
untouched; instead, LightmapBrightnessMixin
replaces the gamma in the BrightnessFactor
calculation inside
LightmapTextureManager.update() with this value.
The original value is not persisted:
the option field always retains the player's
original setting and restores naturally
upon leaving Zombies.
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.name.pla: Allow player movement during Free Camera
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.prettyNa: Allow player movement during Free Camera
Allow player movement: when enabled, the player's body
continues walking during camera flight while the camera
remains at a fixed observation point; when disabled
(default), the body is fully frozen and the camera flies
freely via WASD and mouse input.
The camera is driven by the movement parameters in this
group only while in camera flight mode (i.e. this option
is off).
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.name.pla: Allow player inputs during Free Camera
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.prettyNa: Allow player inputs during Free Camera
Allow player inputs: determines whether attacks, mining,
item use, and interactions remain available during
camera flight.
On: all of the above actions are retained during camera
flight.
Off (default): fully blocked to prevent unintended
actions while the viewpoint is detached from the
player's body.

Camera flight speed multiplier (0.1 ~ 10.0, default 1.0).
Holding the sprint key triples the speed.
Effective only when 'Allow player movement' is off (i.e.
camera flight mode is active).
